title: fix(plugin-security): an organization administrator's assignment removal is judged on the stored row, and its refusal names only values the caller can read
body:
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：组织管理员按 id 删除授权行（`sys_user_position`、`sys_user_permission_set`）时，只要它自己读得到这一行，委派管理闸门（ADR-0090 D12）的组织分支就按存储行判定，和委派分支一样；拒绝提示只写出调用者自己读得到的值。
- 为什么改：落实维护者裁决（ruling of record 6649064874）「ADR-0090 D12 授权闸门按存储行判定，拒绝提示只写出调用者读得到的值」，该裁决覆盖两个分支；#30165 的契约复核把组织分支与之不一致记为 should-fix。
- 风险与回滚：这是放宽：调用者的字段规则或遮罩规则作用在 `position` / `permission_set` 上时，组织边界内的删除现在放行（18.2.0 即按存储行判定）；边界外照旧拒绝；读不到的行与不存在的 id 仍回答 404；修改、插入、租户级管理员、委派分支都不变。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-gate.ts` 的 `organizationTargets`（先以调用者读取判断有没有这一行，读到后取存储行）与 `organizationAdminFailure` 里三处 `mayName` 措辞分支。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/org-admin-assignment-boundary.posture.test.ts`，预期 85/85 通过。
- 需要你做的：确认本 PR 对未发布 changeset `.changeset/org-admin-removal-caller-read.md` 一句话的改写（见 Acceptance notes 第一条）；在你确认之前 `Check Changeset` 按设计保持红。

## What changes

- **The organization branch judges a removal on the stored row.** An organization administrator (`organization_admin` / `organization_admin_no_bypass`) removes an assignment row by id. Whether there is a row is still asked of the caller's own read (`callerRead`, the read door's answer to this caller). Once that read returns the row, `organizationTargets` takes the stored row (`storedRow`) and the organization, position and permission-set checks run on it, as the delegated branch's `delegatedTargets` does. This follows ruling of record 6649064874 ("the ADR-0090 D12 assignment gate judges on the stored row, and its refusal names only what the caller can read"), which covers both branches. No second reader: the branch reuses `callerRead`, `storedRow`, `columnsReadAsStored` and `mayName`, and its target type is now `DelegatedTarget`. No stored read is made for a row the caller's read does not return.
- **One ruling record for the rule, across the package.** Every citation of the stored-row verdict and of the rule that a refusal names only what the caller can read, in this branch's code and in the code it builds on, now names ruling of record 6649064874; the citations of 5985885287 for the read door's not-found answer are kept.
- **A refusal names a value only when the caller can read it.** The row's organization, its position (and the sets that position carries, which are named only beside it) and its permission set are named only when the caller's read returned that column at its stored value (`mayName`). Otherwise the sentence is "the row does not belong to the organization you administer", "the assignment's position is not inside the organization boundary" or "the grant's permission set is not inside the organization boundary", and `details` leaves the value out. A column the caller does read is still named, so the guidance stays specific where it can be.
- **Unchanged.** A row the caller cannot read and an id naming no row keep the read door's `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND`. A read refusal or a store fault propagates as raised. Inserts, tenant-level administrators and the delegated branch are as before. The update path is untouched: an edit in place is refused before any row is looked up, as #30200 set it, and nothing here pins it.
- **Clause-② declaration, measured.** This admits removals the published 18.3.0 refuses, so it widens; that is declared here and in the changeset. It is `Clause-②: no` because it is a runtime permission behaviour change, which `execution-duties.md` places outside Clause ② (its negative boundary: runtime permission and security behaviour is the human-floor security/permission class), and no published contract surface moves: no spec schema, no export (the package's public API is unchanged), no error code. For history: 18.2.0's organization branch judged the stored row (a system read), and 18.3.0's judged the caller's read of it; this keeps 18.3.0's not-found for a row the caller cannot read and takes the verdict from the stored row again.
- **Changeset**: `@objectstack/plugin-security` patch, plus a one-sentence correction of a pending note (Acceptance notes, first item).

## Tests

- `org-admin-assignment-boundary.posture.test.ts` (real `ObjectQL` engine, SQL driver and `SecurityPlugin`), new describe "an organization administrator's removal is judged on the stored row, and its refusal names only values the caller can read", 11 tests:
  - under `group` and `isolated`, for a position or permission set hidden by a field rule and for one partially masked: the caller reads the row without the stored value (precondition, off the read door); the removal of an in-boundary row is admitted and lands; the removal of an out-of-boundary row is refused `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` by the boundary, and neither the stored values (the position, the sets behind it, the permission set) nor the masked value appear anywhere in the serialized answer;
  - under `group` and `isolated`, for the row's organization hidden by a field rule and partially masked: the plugin's own D12 gate, asked as the write door asks it, admits the in-boundary removal on the stored organization, and refuses the out-of-boundary one naming the values the caller reads (the set) and not the organization, through the gate and through the door;
  - control, `group` and `isolated`: callers whose field rules hide a judged column still get the read door's not-found, whole, when they remove a row they cannot read or an id naming no row;
  - control, `single`: a caller whose field rules hide the organization removes its own organization's in-boundary row end to end, and is refused another organization's row without that organization being named.
- **Re-pinned #30165's organization-branch pin** in "an administrator's refused assignment write names a value only when the caller reads it, or wrote it" (all three postures). That pin asserted only that the refusal named no value the caller does not read. It now also asserts the boundary's refusal on the stored row ("is not inside the organization boundary") and adds the same caller's in-boundary removal, admitted.
- `delegated-admin-gate.test.ts`, new top-level describe on the existing organization harness, 20 tests: for both administrator sets, each of `position`, `permission_set` and `organization_id` (both tables) served hidden and masked, in-boundary removals resolve and out-of-boundary ones are refused with the rule's sentence and without the stored or masked value; a column the caller reads keeps its value in the guidance; a row the caller's read does not return and an id naming no row are the unreadable refusal, with no stored read of the addressed row.
- Test names state the rule. The posture rig grows from 74 to 85 tests; its new describe adds about 1.4 s of test time on a loaded shared box, inside the file's declared 20 s budget.

## Acceptance notes

- **Correcting a pending release note: please confirm.** `.changeset/org-admin-removal-caller-read.md` has not shipped as a note (the plugin's `CHANGELOG.md` at 18.3.0 holds none of it). Its sentence "The delegated-administration gate (ADR-0090 D12) now judges that row as the administrator itself reads it, in its own context." is false after this change, so it now reads "now asks the administrator's own read, in its own context, whether that row is there to remove." Two of its bullets are corrected too: the not-found bullet now says "the removal of a row the administrator cannot read" (an edit in place is refused before any row is looked up, so the 404 is a removal's answer), and "A row the administrator can read keeps the answer it had, including the guidance…" now reads "A row the administrator can read is judged on the stored row. A refusal names the organization boundary, and names the row's organization, position or permission set only when the administrator's own read returns that value as stored." Its title, its first paragraph and its "Unchanged" bullet are true of the tree as written. `check-empty-changeset` names the file and stays red by design until a maintainer confirms; restoring the sentence from the base would publish a false one.
- **The row's organization column.** This gate judges it on the stored row too. The rig pins that at the gate under `group` and `isolated`, and end to end under `single`. Under the walled postures a write also answers the write door's own row-level check, which this PR does not change; how that check treats a caller who does not read the organization column is a separate change the seat has ordered.
- **#30200 is merged in.** It reorders the organization branch's update refusal and edits the same docblock as this PR; the merge conflicted in that docblock only, and the resolution keeps both texts (its update-order sentences replace this branch's earlier sentence about edits). This PR's new pins exercise removals only, and `update-by-id-refusal-order.dogfood.test.ts` passes on this head (Verification).
